title: Korea Investment Savings Bank says abnormal external transactions on its mobile homepage leaked data of 8만6433 customers
date_note: Money Today (25 Nov) relays the bank's announcement of 25 Nov; the page dates the abnormal activity to 22-23 Nov, discovered 23 Nov.
geo_basis: country named in the source; no city given, pin at Seoul
summary: Money Today reports that Korea Investment Savings Bank said on 25 November it found, during a 23 November system check, that abnormal external transactions on its mobile homepage between 22:42 on 22 November and 03:35 on 23 November leaked some customers' personal data. The article gives 8만6433 customers and lists name, date of birth, gender, phone number and CI. The bank says it blocked the IP address and access route.
plain: Korea Investment Savings Bank says abnormal outside transactions on its mobile site leaked personal data of 8만6433 customers. The bank says it blocked the IP address and the access route.
exec: A Korean savings bank says personal data of 8만6433 customers leaked through its mobile homepage, per Money Today.

evidence.quote: 지난 23일 시스템 점검 중 22일 22시42분부터 23일 03시35분 사이 당행 모바일 홈페이지에 대한 외부 비정상 거래로 일부 고객의 개인정보가 유출됐음을 확인했다

validation.note: One publisher (Money Today) read, relaying the bank's statement; the bank's own notice was not read. The 8만6433 figure is the article's own; its quoted bank statement does not give a number. Related: hana-savings-bank-reverification-breach-2026-11.
